Card Q&A.a: This effect prevents deletion when this Digimon is the target of an effect with "delete" in its card text. Deletion will still occur if you lose a battle, both players lose a battle, or if this Digimon's DP is reduced to 0.
Card Q&A.q: This card’s [All Turns] effect reads "This Digimon can't be deleted by your opponent's effects." How does this effect work, exactly?

Effect: [All Turns] This Digimon can't be deleted by your opponent's effects.
